title: Myrmidons Project Configuration
description: Schema for the .myrmidons.yaml project configuration file

defaultHost.description: Default agent host used by scripts when no --host flag is given (default: hermes)

aimHost.description: ProjectAgamemnon base URL (alias for AGAMEMNON_URL env var; default: http://localhost:8080)

logLevel.description: Log verbosity for all scripts (default: info)

prunePolicy.description: When to remove agents absent from YAML: 'manual' requires --prune flag, 'auto' prunes on every apply (default: manual)

snapshotRetention.description: Number of days to keep rollback snapshots (default: 7)
